judge_notes.gemini: In this fragmentary honorific inscription from Uthina, 'Tra[iani] Germ(anici) Da[c(ici)]' is in the genitive case (part of a cursus honorum of an unknown official, person 1, who served under Trajan and was 'patron[o coloniae', honored by decree of the '[ordi]nis Ut[hin(ensium)]').
